pages.title: Begin here
pages.readback: The question is the contract for what a successful return should answer.

data.question: What should my 20-minute talk leave the team with?
howto: Write freely in black. Use a colour only for what you want the agent to act on.
Blue for a question, red for a doubt, the highlighter for the one thing that matters.
Photograph the pages and send them back.

pages.title: What should stick
pages.prompt: What should they remember a week later?
pages.readback: Depends on the content; the legend strip still tells you what the human's ink means.

pages.title: Choose the next move
pages.prompt: What will you try first, and what is still open?
pages.readback: A hold is a legitimate outcome — do not push for a decision that isn't there. A commit with no 5-minute action is a wish; say so.

pages.title: Questions for the agent
pages.prompt: Write what you want answered when the pages come back.
pages.readback: Answer in number order, first, before anything unasked. Blanks are not omissions.

pages.title: Send the pages back
pages.prompt: Photograph each page flat and send them back together.
pages.readback: If a page is missing or the ID unreadable, ask for a re-shoot rather than guessing.
